description: Pre-Approved Scope (Article III.2) — standing filesystem and network grants agents may invoke without a fresh Operator Key envelope. v1.1 adds the active-envelope schema and the proposals lane defined by envelopes/syscall-table.json.

envelope_schema.description: Shape of an entry in active[]. An active envelope is a capability: root opened it once; each use is checked mechanically and cited in FRANK. proposals[] entries use the same shape with status=proposed and no force.

fields.verb: string — must equal the table row's verb name; mismatch with verb_id is a registry integrity fault, not a judgment call
fields.grantee: agent id from fleet.json (or list) — the process(es) holding the fd
fields.bounds: object — keys MUST be exactly the verb's bounds signature from the table: no missing keys, no extra keys. The checker validates call args field-by-field against these values. A bounds object that does not match its verb's signature makes the envelope VOID, not loosely interpretable.
fields.issued_by: root — always; envelope.issue is not grantable
fields.ratified_via: how root's act is evidenced: pgp | in-session statement recorded in FRANK ledger entry <id> | commit signature
fields.expires_at: UTC date or null — null means until revoked, not forever
fields.max_count: int or null — null means unmetered
fields.use_count_source: always 'frank' — the count is DERIVED by counting envelope_citation entries in the ledger, never stored here; a stored counter is mutable state an agent could touch, a derived count is not
fields.revoked: object or absent — {at, by, reason}; revocation appends, never deletes (register discipline)
fields.notes: human context — NEVER read by the checker

citation.description: Every application writes a FRANK entry before the action executes.

active.notes: THE PLANTING — the envelope that licenses the orchestrator seat to exist. Grants willow (OPERATOR ring; verb 13 min_ring OPERATOR) the act of matching calls against this registry, citing envelopes, and routing faults per the errno table. Self-grounding by design: the seat's own authority sits in the same register, under the same law, as everyone else's. Unmetered and non-expiring because the seat is a standing office, but revocable like any envelope — revocation of this one entry shuts the seat down whole. Drafted by willow 2026-07-06 (session e2b05d0a) as a proposal; ratified and moved to active[] the same day by root (verb 12) — willow scribed the edit under the authority of the cited FRANK entry.

active.ratified_via: in-session statement recorded in FRANK ledger entry 25eacc8c-e500-411f-939f-6700ffc50cc5
active.notes: First action envelope — the flagship Dual Commit case. Licenses willow to merge PRs into willow-2.0 master WHERE CI is green (requires_ci is checked against the PR's actual check state at merge time, never asserted from memory). Proposed values, root's to adjust at ratification: 20 merges, expiring 2026-08-06 (one month) — deliberately metered and expiring, unlike the planting, because merges are the salami-slicing surface the drift-budget design worries about; expiry forces a review cadence. Excluded by omission: force-anything (verb 3 force field, ungranted), foreign repos, non-master base branches — all EAMBIG/ENOENT faults. KNOWN SCHEMA DRIFT flagged for syscall-table 0.2: verb 5's bounds signature lists max_count/expires_at, but envelope-schema 0.1 hoisted those to envelope-level fields; this proposal follows the envelope schema (metering at envelope level, bounds carry repo/base_branch/requires_ci). Table signature should drop max_count/expires_at from bounds at next root edit — recorded here rather than edited there, because editing the table is verb 12, root only. FUTURE TIGHTENING (from ccfo audit, issue #211): requires_ci should become named check contexts from trusted actors, not just 'checks green' — adopt when the checker becomes code.

proposals.notes: Dispatch grant for the orchestrator seat, earned by evidence: three console-resolved ENOENT dispatches on 2026-07-06 (FRANK d359b53f, 388e3f5c chain; results a6986a1a, 197488f8, 28187495) proved the lanes (claude-code, cursor) and the build loop (hanuman commit 17d3a84 citing its work order). Bounds follow verb 11's signature exactly: to_agents is the fleet.json roster minus willow itself and schmidt (sean/schmidt workspace is out of the seat's coordination scope); a call's task_class must be a member of the granted set. Three classes: orchestrator-injection (probes/continuity checks into resumed sessions), build-work-order (spec-out work the seat must not build itself — the magistrate-writes-no-code rule made operational), verification-probe (independent re-checks of reported work). Deliberately metered (40) and expiring same day as env-pr.merge-willow2-master (2026-08-06) so both grants come up for review together. Per verb 11's table note, authority does not widen in transit: a dispatched task carries this envelope's citation and the receiver's own calls check against it — dispatch is never a privilege laundry. Constraints living outside bounds (dispatcher's own law, not envelope fields): payloads are messages not shell, never skip-permissions, never into a live session, ledgered before execution. Drafted by willow 2026-07-06 (session e2b05d0a); forceless until root fills issued_at/ratified_via and moves to active[] (verb 12).
